ai_summary: Driving Licence (Sarathi / Parivahan) is a central government service under Ministry of Road Transport and Highways in the Transport category, available both.
ai_explanation: Driving Licence (Sarathi / Parivahan) is Application for learner's licence, driving licence, and renewals through the Parivahan Sarathi portal. Eligibility: Minimum age 16 (gearless <50cc) / 18 (LMV); pass driving test.. Benefits: Legal authorisation to drive; valid identity/address proof.. You can apply both via https://parivahan.gov.in. Processing time is typically Learner's licence same day (online test); DL after driving test, ~7-30 days. and fees are Learner's ~Rs.150; DL ~Rs.200+ (varies by state RTO)..
